steps.name: Mercenary Captain
steps.text: How's she doing?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: She's still here, following along.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: You know what a stubborn runt she is.

steps.name: Mercenary Captain
steps.text: Try to talk to her again...

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Damn it, Grimm, you're going senile, aren't you?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: If you're going to regret it now, why did you even bring her here?

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: Cut the crap.

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: We were in sticky situation with that deal at the black market. Both of them moneybags wanted each other dead. And with the merch gone, they'd only blame us for the mess.

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: If we hadn't brought the kid with us, she would've died in the city.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: I know that, but now you're chasing her away, and she's got nowhere to go.

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: Just gotta find her a random town... As long as there's work, there's still a way out for her.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: You really believe that?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: I mean it. For her sake, you should just train her. Has she ever seen blood? I mean real blood, not a couple hornbeasts getting slaughtered.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Grimm, enough daydreaming. We're already on our way to Londinium. We'll run into more clashes.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: And she's a Sarkaz.

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: Yeah. Shut up already.

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: I know what to do with her.

a.text: He's not the first one to try to talk me into this, and I know he won't be the last.
Am I too soft on that Paprika kid? I'll admit it. Maybe a little.
When the rotten girl came onboard a few years ago, she was still a kid, through and through. She lost her parents and had to make a living to keep herself and her grandma back home from going hungry.
I figured I'd take care of her some, given how young she was.
When I was her age...
Whenever I had nothing to eat, I had to pluck out all the metal trinkets from the dead bodies' at the burial sites. A bag got me a big loaf of bread.
When you think about it like that, life may still be tough for kids these days, but they have it much better than our generation.
They've got food, clothes, and the strength to scream about how unfair Columbia treats the Sarkaz—What do kids like her know?
Does she know what this trip to Londinium is about?
Hah, like hell she would.
Her little punk ass hasn't even seen Kazdel for real.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Jerk, jerk... you great big jerk...

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Treating me like a kid again... I'll make you regret this someday!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Hey.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: —! A raid?!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: If this was a raid, you'd be dead already.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Oh... what? Don't scare me like that.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: I don't have time to come scare you. You're scaring yourself, not being alert enough.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I'm a medic. I wasn't that good at fighting to begin with.

spans.text: good at fighting to begin with.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Besides, I was... I was thinking about things. That's why I didn't notice.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Fine, whatever you say.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: So? Still mad about Old Grimm?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Hmph... Of course!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: He wanted me off the team now? Don't you think that's awful?

spans.text: He wanted me off the team

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Ugh.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I'm a merc. I'm part of the team. Why'd he want me gone?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Why doesn't he want me to come with you guys to Londinium? I've been on so many missions with you!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: This gig's different.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I don't see what's so special about it... It's a bit far, but there's lots of money in it!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: If there's one thing that's not the same as usual...

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: It's when Grimm came back that day and said we had to pack and leave right away. I'd never seen him so worked up.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Usually, nothing matters to him, but not then. He even said that if we win this time, we'll have a much better future.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Is that true?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Who knows?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: I just want my money up front. The rest I haven't thought about.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Eh, that's fair.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Grimm thinks I don't know nothing, but what does it matter as long as we make money?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: As long as Nana doesn't go hungry, all gigs are the same. What else do I have to know?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: If we really get that much money... I want to buy Nana a better house. The place she's living in now has a leaky roof, and she keeps telling me her knees hurt.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Oh, right. If Grimm wants one, I could even buy him a decent birthday present.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: You want to celebrate his birthday? Does he even remember something as pointless as his birthday?

spans.text: birthday? Does he even remember something as pointless as his birthday?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: How is that pointless? It's like the opposite of pointless!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: If you don't remind yourself every year, you might just forget that a year has come and gone, that you've gotten a year bigger, a year older.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Doesn't that sound scary to you?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Kinda?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: What kind of lame answer is that?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Fine, whatever you say.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: The way I see it, if you told Grimm himself what you just told me, he might just agree... No, he might even be less inclined to let you follow us.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Huh? What's that mean...?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: (And I was going to convince her to leave...)

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: (Forget it.)

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Never mind. Keep following, then. I'm heading back to the front.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Sheesh, what's with that? I hate people who don't finish their thoughts.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Acting all mysterious...
The man has already walked away. There are roughly twenty men in the team up ahead. Paprika can only faintly make out the shadow of the last man in the group.
The girl stays quiet for a moment. She looks down and pulls something out of her pocket.
A finger sleeve made of wool and bright in color.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Grimm's definitely gonna say it looks too colorful.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Well, what does it matter? It looks prettier when it's colorful.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: If he tells me to go away one more time...

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I won't give him his present!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: (What's that noise?)

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: (Was that just my imagination?)

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Who's there? Come out!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Hmph!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Got you!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Who are you? And what are you after?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Hey, you—

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Wait... Don't even think about it!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Huff... hah...

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: G-Got you...!

steps.name: Black Market Brawler
steps.text: I never expected a young lass like you would spot me.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: What does that make you? You got yourself caught by a young lass.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: You won't get away. Now spill it! Who are you?!

steps.name: Black Market Brawler
steps.text: Hah, what a naive kid. I'll admit you're not half bad. The Sarkaz really live up to their reputation.

steps.name: Black Market Brawler
steps.text: But you...

steps.name: Black Market Brawler
steps.text: It doesn't matter how good a naive, boneheaded kid fights. It doesn't change the fact that you're a kid.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Why you...!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: (No, Paprika. He's provoking you on purpose... Don't fall for it. Calm down.)

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I'm warning you. Don't you try to buy time with stupid stuff.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Now answer my question, if you know what's good for you!

steps.name: Black Market Brawler
steps.text: Here's a free lesson, Sarkaz punk.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Answer me!

steps.name: Black Market Brawler
steps.text: If you know someone's stalling, you shouldn't hang around and let things drag out—

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: What? You...

steps.name: Black Market Brawler B
steps.text: Are you done yet?

steps.name: Black Market Brawler B
steps.text: Having a nice chat with your new girlfriend, are you?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Shit! Y-You...

steps.name: Black Market Brawler
steps.text: —Do it!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Dammit! You... crooked sons of bitches!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: (No, if both of them attack at once... I can't dodge!)

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Ugh!

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: Eyes open! Look at your opponent. Raise your weapon and block!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Ungh!

steps.name: Black Market Brawler
steps.text: Ugh, here comes the nasty bastard.

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: Don't worry about anyone else. Focus on your target.

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: Don't worry about getting hurt. In battle, never let go of your weapon!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Black Market Brawler B
steps.text: Don't you underestimate me!

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: Now! Attack!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Haah!

steps.name: Black Market Brawler
steps.text: Gah!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Hah... Haah! Don't underestimate you?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Right back at you—You jerks. Don't—Don't underestimate me!

steps.name: Black Market Brawler B
steps.text: Hah, where're you aiming at, punk?!

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: What are you doing?!

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: Have you forgotten everything I've taught you?! Aim for his vitals!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I-I know...!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Haaaaagh—!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*...

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: *pant*...

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Got them.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Grimm!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: You see that? I took them both down myself!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Grimm...?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: What's wrong? A-Are you mad?

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: What did I teach you before?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Don't underestimate the enemy, don't hold back, and aim for the enemy's vitals in one go.

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: And what were you doing?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I... I didn't miss on purpose. I... uh...

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I mean, you're here. It's not a problem.

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: What if... in the future, I'm not around?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: But why would you ever not be around?

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: No one sticks around forever. Don't be stupid.

steps.name: Black Market Brawler
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: They're still alive?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Uh... yeah. I-I knocked them out...

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: Why didn't you kill them outright?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: That's not really necessary, right...?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Hey, how about I tie them up?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: That way, they can't call for help...

a.text: Sometimes I wonder.
What exactly can I teach a kid like her?
Should I teach her how to become a 'real Sarkaz merc?' Should I teach her those so-called rules I've put together from my experiences?
Would she really accept anything I teach her and eventually grow up to become the kind of Sarkaz I've met aplenty. The kind of Sarkaz like me?
That's definitely not a future I'd look forward to.
But if I teach her nothing...
A naive Sarkaz like her will have no future.

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: Paprika.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: Watch carefully.
The old mercenary unsheathes the sharp blade he is carrying at his waist and drives it into the defeated man's throats as the young girl watches.
His red blood spatters onto Paprika's knees and her shoes; the scalding heat seeps through the fabric and reaches her skin.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: But... Why...?

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: They're from the black market, and they came for us.

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: If I hadn't noticed their movement just now, it could've been you who was lying on the ground here.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I know!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I know they were up to no good! And that if it wasn't for you, I would've been in danger...

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: There's one more. He's my quarry. I'll end him.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: (I need to kill him... Right, I have to.)

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: (Just stab him. Relax, Paprika. This isn't hard...)

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: ...Phew...

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: What are you hesitating for?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I'm not...!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: (I'm not hesitating... I'm a merc. This is just killing... just killing my enemy!)

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: (What is there to hesitate about? I... I...)

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I'll waste him right now... right now!

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: That's enough.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: What? But Grimm, I still haven't—

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: You can't bring yourself to do it.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: No! Trust me... I can!

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: You still don't understand a thing.

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: If you can't even kill a man like him, I can say for sure there is no future for you as a merc.

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: You will die soon. Dying on a battlefield somewhere is still a half-decent outcome, but you could die somewhere that doesn't even matter, and I'd have to go collect your body.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: But I am a merc!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: All of us mercs will die one day. Didn't you say that yourself?

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: All of us?

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: Hah, you're not one of us.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Grimm, sometimes, I'm scared...

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: Of what?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Just like you said, it could've been me who got killed here today. If it wasn't for you, I would've been killed for sure.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: It could take you guys a long time to find me, and then it'd take an even longer time for Nana back home to find out.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: That's what happened when Fred died. I still remember.

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: Death and parting are a normal part of life.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Yeah... I know. You always say that.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I'm not scared of dying. I really am not.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: But I'm scared of keeping Nana waiting for me to go home, even if I won't ever make it back.

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: I'll let you off this time.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Grimm...! No, wait, I really can—

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: I've seen enough of this charade. We're done here.

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: But, kid, remember this. If you follow us, sooner or later you will run into a situation where you gotta kill.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Yeah... I get it...

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: Do you now? I don't see it.

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: This might end up killing you.

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: Paprika.

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: Don't go to Londinium. You're not cut out for it.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Didn't you say that as long as we win this war, we'll have a better future?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I can fight. I will definitely be helpful!

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: This is about more than just fighting.

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: I'm putting everything on the line for this mission. Because I've seen it before.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Seen what before?

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: I've seen us Sarkaz with a home.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Home...

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: Maybe it won't be all that good, but as long as there's a shred of hope, I'm willing to fight for it.

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: But you're different. You still have a choice.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I... I have a choice?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I don't know...

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Where else could I go, if I don't go with you?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I want to head back to my hometown and live my days like before, but... can we really do that?

a.text: I know what kind of path I'm on.
Becoming a merc is never a Sarkaz's choice, but throwing yourself into war is. Setting out on this journey is the best and only choice I have.
The kid says she's not scared of dying.
I didn't argue.
I know it's not that she's not afraid. She never had the chance to understand and never faced anything like that before.
Fear has always kept at bay two kinds of men:
One is like me, and the other like her.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I've thought about this before. This mission in Londinium will be harder than all the missions we've been on, right?

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: Maybe.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: One day, you might collapse on the ground somewhere and lose your life just like that.

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: In that case, I'm not gonna prepare a birthday present ahead of time next year.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Here. Your present for this year.

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: A finger glove?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Don't you say it's too colorful, a waste of time, or that it's not something you need!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I-I'm not gonna be sad if you die. I promise you. Death and parting is nothing to us Sarkaz.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: But if we can avoid dying... even if we get the living hell beaten out of us, even if we don't get paid...

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: None of that matters. I won't even be bothered if we don't earn a single dime after this long trip!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: At the very least...

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I hope we'll all come back together after the mission is over.

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: How naive.

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: Are all young Sarkaz these days this naive? My kind of Sarkaz never think like that.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Why are you digging at me again?!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Can't Sarkaz wish for the people around them to be safe?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: That's really how I feel... and I'm a Sarkaz!

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: Sarkaz like you die on the battlefield.

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: And I'd rather not have your death on my conscience, kid.

steps.name: Grimm
steps.text: Let's go.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: What's that supposed to mean...? Hey, wait for me!
